d: Jet black, straight hair with long lengths and blunt bangs frames a face with a mature, young adult appearance and sharp, crimson eyes. The slender build is dressed in a short, white sleeveless dress with a plunging neckline and side slits, worn under a flowing black outer robe featuring a large, white dragon motif on the interior lining. Black thigh-high stockings with lace trim lead down to pointed black heels, while a red cord is tied around the neck as a choker. The figure holds a long black sword with gold accents and red tassels.
